planets.name: TOI-2384 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2384 with a 2.14-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-2384 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2384. Its orbit and size follow Bryant et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
